Title: AI Engineer
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking an AI Engineer to join our innovative and impact-driven Data Science and Analytics team. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines solid software, data, and ML engineering skills with hands-on Generative AI experience—and a data scientist's curiosity for how models behave. You build the pipelines, tooling, and applications that turn AI and LLM models into dependable production software. As an AI Engineer, you will independently own the end-to-end delivery of defined AI projects—from data pipeline through deployed application. You will make sound technical decisions within your scope, partner directly with cross-functional stakeholders, and guide junior engineers on specific problems as you deliver measurable business value. How You Will Do It Generative AI Systems & Applications Develop and deploy Generative AI systems and LLM-powered applications (e.g., GPT, Claude, LLaMA) for use cases such as enterprise search, document summarization, and conversational AI. Apply prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and orchestration techniques to adapt foundation models for domain-specific applications. Build agentic workflows and task-specific AI agents—using Palantir AIP or the Microsoft Agent Framework—that orchestrate tools, retrieval, and reasoning. Evaluate and improve model outputs for accuracy, relevance, latency, and cost, applying data science techniques to measure and validate performance. Data, ML & Software Engineering Build and maintain the data pipelines that feed AI systems—ingestion, transformation, and ETL across structured and unstructured sources (e.g., Snowflake, Azure). Develop and operate ML pipelines and MLOps workflows—training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring—using CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and model serving. Build reusable components, services, and APIs around AI models that help the team ship features faster. Implement retrieval and embedding workflows (RAG, vector databases) for scalable, accurate knowledge retrieval. Apply software engineering best practices—testing, version control, and code review—across your projects. Business Impact & Stakeholder Communication Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business challenges into AI solutions. Support workshops and proofs-of-concept that demonstrate the value of LLM and agent use cases across business units. Translate model outputs, data findings, and technical tradeoffs into clear insights for non-technical audiences. Mentorship & Collaboration Guide junior engineers on specific technical problems and code quality. Contribute to design discussions and technical decisions within the team. Share knowledge and help raise the bar on engineering and data science practices. Qualifications & Experience Education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical or quantitative discipline. 2–5 years of experience in software, data, ML engineering, or data science, including hands-on work with LLMs or generative AI. Demonstrated success delivering data or ML pipelines and AI/ML solutions to production. Experience with data science fundamentals—exploratory analysis, statistical modeling, or classic ML (classification, regression, forecasting). Experience with cloud AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI/Azure ML, AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, or Google Cloud Vertex AI. Technical Expertise Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with good software engineering habits—testing, version control, and clean code. Hands-on experience with the Generative AI stack: prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), LLM orchestration, and agent frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework). Experience building ETL and ML pipelines and applying MLOps practices (CI/CD, Docker, model serving). Familiarity with data science libraries and workflows—pandas, scikit-learn, and model evaluation and experimentation. Experience with JCI's stack—or comparable platforms—including Palantir AIP, Azure ML, Microsoft Agent Framework, Power Automate, and Snowflake. Working knowledge of embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval systems. Soft Skills Ability to own projects and communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly. Strong collaboration skills across product, engineering, and business teams. Comfortable presenting technical and analytical work to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Self-directed problem solver who manages priorities independently. Preferred Qualifications Experience with IoT, edge analytics, or smart building systems. Familiarity with LLMOps, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks. Data science depth—statistical modeling, experimentation, or deep learning (forecasting, computer vision, or NLP). Experience with the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint, Power Platform, Snowflake). Knowledge of data privacy and governance considerations for enterprise LLM usage. Johnson Controls does not request pregnancy or HIV testing as a condition for hiring, continued employment, or promotion , in accordance with its commitment to labor equality and non-discrimination.

Title: Junior AI/ML Engineer
Description: We are hiring Junior AI/ML Engineers to help build AI agents that handle customer conversations through voice and chat. You'll work on the retrieval, orchestration, APIs, and integrations behind these systems, helping turn working prototypes into reliable production solutions. You'll collaborate with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to develop AI-powered experiences that are practical, secure, and effective. We welcome candidates with relevant professional experience, internships, research, or hands-on projects who are eager to develop their skills and contribute to real-world AI applications. What You'll Do Build AI agents: Develop conversational agents that interact with users, call tools and APIs, and hand conversations off to human agents when needed. Develop retrieval pipelines: Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that help AI agents answer questions using approved information sources. Integrate systems: Connect AI agents with CRMs, ticketing systems, databases, and messaging channels. Build and manage APIs: Work with API gateways, authentication, rate limits, and versioning. Support voice AI development: Help build voice agents using speech-to-text, large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech in English and Spanish. Test and improve quality: Use evaluations, automated tests, and guardrails to improve accuracy, reliability, and safety. Support deployment and monitoring: Ship and maintain solutions through CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation. Collaborate across teams: Work with engineering, CX design, and operations colleagues to turn prototypes into production-ready solutions. Our Technology Stack Our primary cloud platform is Microsoft Azure, but experience with AWS or Google Cloud is also valuable. Relevant technologies include Python, Git, Docker, SQL, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, REST APIs, API gateways, webhooks, messaging systems, and cloud-based AI services. Experience with any one of the named tools in each relevant area is sufficient. You don't need to have used every framework or platform listed. Working Environment This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates based in Colombia or Mexico. You'll work with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to build and improve AI-powered customer conversation solutions. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and a willingness to learn. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to AI agents, retrieval systems, integrations, and voice AI applications while developing your engineering skills. ﻿ ﻿Hiring Process To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process. Our process includes: Resume Review Pre-Screen Questionnaire One-Way Video Interview Live Interview Please Note ﻿This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills. All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position. Requirements: What You'll Bring 1–3 years of experience in software engineering or ML engineering. Relevant internships and research experience count. Solid Python skills and familiarity with Git, Docker, and basic SQL. Experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Hands-on experience with an LLM API, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Azure OpenAI. Experience building an AI agent that calls tools or APIs, using a framework such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. Experience building a RAG pipeline, including document chunking, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval tuning. Experience building and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, rate limits, and versioning, with some exposure to API gateways. Experience connecting systems through webhooks, SDKs, or message queues, such as integrating an application with a CRM or database. Understanding of ML fundamentals, including embeddings, train/test splits, and evaluation metrics such as precision and recall. Professional written and spoken English and Spanish. Based in Colombia or Mexico. Candidates with strong foundational knowledge and relevant academic, internship, research, or personal project experience are encouraged to apply. Nice to Have Experience with speech AI or voice agent technologies, such as Azure AI Speech, Whisper, LiveKit, or Pipecat. Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or integration platforms such as Azure Logic Apps or n8n. Experience with CRM and contact center APIs, including Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or Zendesk. Familiarity with LLM evaluation tools such as Langfuse or Ragas. Cloud AI certifications or other relevant technical certifications.

Rediseño de procesos y documentación del estado actual y estado deseado. Gestión de proyectos y/o gestión de producto. Gestión del cambio y adopción de nuevas soluciones. Idioma Inglés avanzado. Construir y analizar las métricas de pólizas individuales considerando el inventario, primas promedios y descuentos para la presentación de información a la Dirección de Suscripción de Autos. Title: Supply Planner II (SAP S/4HANA & Planning Experience)
Description: Job Description As a Supply Planner II here at Honeywell, you will manage supply planning to ensure timely delivery of materials and products. Collaborate with procurement, production, and logistics to optimize inventory and enhance supply chain efficiency. You will report directly to our Materials Management Director, and you’ll work out of our MTY location on a hybrid work schedule. As a S4 Supply Chain Planning Analyst here at Honeywell Technologies, you will play a vital role in leveraging data analytics to enhance S4 planning processes. You will analyze supply chain data to provide actionable insights that improve planning accuracy, optimize inventory levels, and support decision-making across the supply chain network. In this role, your work will provide insights to improve supply chain efficiency, reduce costs, and increase customer satisfaction by ensuring the right products are available at the right time through data-driven supply planning strategies. Responsibilities Develop and maintain SAP S/4HANA reporting solutions supporting supply planning, inventory management, material availability, and planning execution. Design, build, and enhance S/4 reporting dashboards, KPI scorecards, and analytical reports used by planning, operations, and leadership teams. Develop S4 based reporting to support supply planning and execution. Develop and maintain analytics dashboards and reports to support supply planning decision-making. Analyze supply planning data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including procurement, production, and logistics to align supply planning analytics with business objectives. Utilize advanced analytics tools and techniques to optimize supply planning processes. Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying automation opportunities and process enhancements. Support roadmap for AI initiatives and implementation. Identify and mitigate risks associated with data quality issues that could lead to MRP failures or supply chain disruptions. Provide ongoing support and training to stakeholders on analytics practices and tools. Monitor and report on data quality metrics, implementing corrective actions as necessary. Qualifications YOU MUST HAVE 4+ years of experience in supply chain analytics or supply planning analytics. 2+ years of experience transforming SAP S/4HANA planning data into actionable business insights through SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Fiori Reporting, Embedded Analytics, CDS Views, and advanced visualization tools. Experience with data visualization tools like Power BI. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Proven experience in supply chain processes. Strong understanding of MRP systems and data management principles. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at all levels. Knowledge of supply planning processes and inventory management principles. WE VALUE Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. Supply Chain Certifications such as CSCP / CPIM / CPSM / Lean Six Sigma. Proficiency in data analytics tools and programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL. Familiarity with advanced analytics techniques including predictive modeling and machine learning. About Us Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

Description: #BrillaEnAlEn como Investigador Jr de Excelencia en Procesos de R&D Si te apasiona la mejora continua, el análisis de datos y la optimización de procesos, ¡esta vacante es para ti! En este rol, contribuirás a fortalecer las prácticas de excelencia en Investigación y Desarrollo (R&D), dando seguimiento a estándares de calidad, auditorías internas y metodologías Lean-Agile. Serás parte de un equipo que impulsa procesos más eficientes, estandarizados y colaborativos, generando valor a través de la mejora continua y la gestión del conocimiento. En Grupo AlEn llevamos más de 75 años transformando hogares y comunidades con soluciones de limpieza innovadoras y marcas icónicas. Somos una empresa orgullosamente mexicana con presencia en México, Estados Unidos, Centroamérica y el Caribe, y nuestros productos están presentes en el 97% de los hogares mexicanos. Nuestro propósito es construir un mundo más limpio y sostenible para ti. ✨ ¿Qué harás en este rol? Coordinar y ejecutar actividades de auditorías internas de prácticas de excelencia, incluyendo 7's, Buenas Prácticas de Laboratorio (BPL) y estándares aplicables. Elaborar informes de auditoría, consolidar hallazgos y dar seguimiento al cierre de acciones correctivas y preventivas. Identificar desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora mediante el análisis de datos y la colaboración con diferentes áreas. Monitorear la aplicación de metodologías Lean y Kanban, así como el cumplimiento de estándares operativos. Apoyar en la actualización de tableros visuales, flujos de trabajo, procedimientos y materiales de capacitación. Dar seguimiento a iniciativas de mejora continua, evaluando su avance y efectividad. Generar reportes e indicadores que permitan identificar tendencias y oportunidades de optimización en los procesos. Documentar y actualizar procedimientos, guías, buenas prácticas y lecciones aprendidas. Mantener organizados los repositorios de conocimiento, asegurando el control documental y la trazabilidad de la información. Brindar soporte operativo a usuarios y apoyar en actividades de capacitación y transferencia de conocimiento. 🎯 ¿Qué buscamos? Licenciatura o Ingeniería en Química, Biotecnología, Industrial o carreras afines. Experiencia profesional de 1 a 3 años, preferentemente en gestión de estándares de calidad o soporte a procesos de Investigación y Desarrollo. Conocimientos básicos de procesos de Investigación y Desarrollo (R&D), auditorías internas y gestión de proyectos. Conocimiento de metodologías de mejora continua, como Lean y Kanban. Manejo intermedio de análisis de datos, Microsoft Office y Excel. Conocimientos básicos de Power BI y plataformas como JIRA, Safety Culture y Uncountable. Inglés intermedio. Habilidades de organización, análisis de información, comunicación efectiva, atención al detalle y trabajo colaborativo. 👉 ¿Qué puedes esperar al unirte a Grupo AlEn? Bienestar integral: compensación competitiva, prestaciones superiores a la ley y beneficios que te acompañan en cada etapa de tu vida. Desarrollo que impulsa: aprendizaje que inspira y proyectos que te desafían. Entorno colaborativo, abierto y ágil en donde puedes proponer, crear, transformar. Propósito que inspira: construimos un mundo más limpio para ti. ¿List@ para tu siguiente reto? ¡Postúlate ahora! Ven y #BrillaenAlEn En Grupo AlEn promovemos una cultura de inclusión y equidad. Todos nuestros procesos de selección son gratuitos y están abiertos a cualquier persona, sin distinción de edad, origen étnico, religión, género, identidad u orientación sexual, estado civil, condición física o de salud, ideología política o cualquier otra característica personal.
